question: Which materials are named as suitable for the vessels being described?
premises: A vessel may be made of clay
A vessel may be made of bell metal
A vessel may be made of copper metal
inference: Suitable vessels include those made of clay, tortoise-derived material, bell metal, and copper.
plain_english: O Goddess, they may be made of clay, born of a tortoise, made of bell metal, or made of copper.
